subject: Ops constraints mapping & expansion agenda
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops constraints mapping & expansion agenda

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps:

Pain points / goals we captured:
- Intermittent latency spikes on RAG queries during ingestion windows (20–30% slower at peak).
- Token costs from long-context RAG pipelines are ~2.4x higher than estimated.
- PHI-containing transcripts require private deployment (VPC + managed KMS) and audit logs.
- Need steady throughput for embedding refresh jobs (nightly batch + realtime updates).

Current footprint you shared (approx): 10M tokens/month; 250k embeddings/day; pronounced peak during Tue/Wed ingestion windows.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Please share a 30/60/90-day usage snapshot and the top 3 workloads by traffic (CSV or exported query is fine).
2) We will assemble a short Dedicated pilot proposal (config + cost delta + SLA) — draft due by EOD 5/4.
3) Technical checklist: network/VPC constraints, KMS owner, any compliance questionnaire items that must be completed before pilot.

Timeline: if pilot looks good we'd propose a 2-week validation window starting week of 5/24 and aiming for production commit 7/1.

Attachment: ops-mapping-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I will follow up with the pilot proposal and a light technical checklist.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Ops constraints mapping & expansion agenda

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few specifics and attaching the usage export you requested.

Quick clarifications:
- The 10M tokens/month number is a blended estimate; peak ingestion windows push effective tokens/hour much higher (seen 3–4x the average in late March).
- Top workloads by traffic: 1) Customer chat RAG (realtime), 2) Document ingestion + search index updates (batch), 3) Meeting transcript summarization (near-realtime).
- Compliance: we can host PHI under a VPC with KMS but need an SOC2 + encryption audit trail — happy to share our security datasheet.

Attachments:
- veridian_usage_30-90d.csv
- top-workloads-summary.txt

We are open to a Dedicated pilot. Two asks up front: 1) can you include an expected cost delta for the pilot vs hosted; 2) list any firewall/VPC peering requirements we should prep for.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform | Veridian Labs
alex@veridianlabs.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ops constraints mapping & expansion agenda — Veridian usage attached

Forwarding the usage export Alex sent. Key takeaways for the team and proposed owners: 

- Workloads: customer chat RAG (realtime) + ingestion batch + transcript summarization. Chat has the tightest P95 SLO target (<= 150ms p95 ideally).
- Peak behavior: ingestion evenings (UTC) causes KV cache churn — suspected cause of latency spikes.
- Compliance: Veridian will require VPC + KMS + audit logs; security will want SOC2 evidence.

Proposed pilot approach (short):
A) Pilot config: 2 x A10 GPUs (or equivalent T4x with quantized model) behind the Redwood Dedicated runtime; 24/7 capacity for 2 weeks to validate stability at ingestion peaks. (Karthik — can you validate exact sizing?)
B) Acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 200ms for chat under pilot load; embedding job throughput >= 200k/day without queueing.
C) Timeline: draft proposal attached (redwood-dedicated-proposal-20270504.pdf). Target pilot start: week of 5/24; pilot wrap and decision: week of 6/7; production commit target: 7/1.

Action items / owners:
- Karthik: technical sizing + config recommendation (reply by 5/6).
- Vanessa: finance/tiered pricing delta and short commercial note for the proposal (5/6).
- Kimberly: finalize proposal and send to Veridian (5/4) — attached.

Quoted from Alex's attachment for context:
> Top workloads by traffic: 1) Customer chat RAG (realtime), 2) Document ingestion + search index updates (batch), 3) Meeting transcript summarization (near-realtime).

Please reply with any constraints I missed. If you all are aligned I will push the proposal live to Alex and request the security kickoff items.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-proposal-20270504.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex@veridianlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops constraints mapping & expansion agenda — sizing notes

Thanks for the context, Kim. Quick technical notes / confirmations: 

- Sizing: For the pilot, 2 x A10 is a reasonable starting point if we run a quantized 13B for chat. If Veridian prefers lower cost we can prototype T4x with int8 quantization but expect ~10–15% latency delta.
- KV cache churn: we should enable prefix caching and extend KV retention for ingestion windows — reduces regen and read amplification. I recommend a KV retention of 48h for the pilot.
- Batching: configure dynamic batching with a target latency cap of 120ms; that will keep p95 under control during peaks if queue depth remains bounded.
- Security intake: please open an internal security intake ticket (SEC-VER-78321) and copy Alex's security contact. We will need SOC2 attestation and KMS key ARN + peering CIDR.

I will put a short config spec into the Drive folder (link below) and will update by EOD 5/6. Once Vanessa confirms the commercial delta we can push the pilot proposal.

Karthik
